records.speaker: Guildmaster
records.context: The Guildmaster pitches an old map and describes the dagger. Hodram sees the item choices, declines the Loom, buys the map, then opens Sell Items.
records.source_meaning: The player is in luck. The Guildmaster has an old map said to show where a legendary treasure lies.
records.localization_note: Restore the Guildmaster's possession of the map and keep the claim as hearsay. The native literal profile packs the sentence into two complete rows.
records.english: You're in luck! I've got an old map said to lead to legendary treasure.
records.clean_Japanese:
お、あんた運がいいね
伝説の秘宝の在りかを示しているという
古の地図がうちにおいてあるぜ
records.previous_English:
You're in luck!
 This old map may lead
 to legendary treasure.

records.speaker: Guildmaster
records.context: The Guildmaster pitches an old map and describes the dagger. Hodram sees the item choices, declines the Loom, buys the map, then opens Sell Items.
records.source_meaning: The Guildmaster gives the selected price and asks if the player will buy the item.
records.localization_note: The price and buy question stay together across the proven item-price range. Use the existing ordinary digits and preserve the original argument.
records.english: Want to buy it for %s coins?
records.clean_Japanese:
そいつは
金貨%s枚だ
買うかい？
records.previous_English: That's %s coins. Want to buy it?

records.speaker: Guildmaster
records.context: The Guildmaster pitches an old map and describes the dagger. Hodram sees the item choices, declines the Loom, buys the map, then opens Sell Items.
records.source_meaning: The Guildmaster stops the player and says there is nothing eligible to sell.
records.localization_note: Wait keeps the interruption. Nothing to sell refers to this Guild list, and the complete reply fits a line.
records.english: Wait. You've got nothing to sell.
records.clean_Japanese:
おいおい
売れるような品は持ってねえだろう
records.previous_English: Hold on. You don't have anything to sell.
